u0: No matching key is held and the locked door has not been opened. Search the starting room for the key whose color matches the door, then pick it up to advance toward opening the door.
u1: The matching key has been acquired at least once, but the door has not yet been opened. If still holding the key, go to the door and toggle it open; if the key was dropped or otherwise lost before opening the door, first recover it, since losing it before the door opens incurs a penalty and opening the door remains the current objective.
u2: The door has been opened at least once, so access to the second room is available, but the mission-designated box has not been picked up. Enter the box room; if still carrying the key, drop it safely because the door is already open, reopen the door if necessary, then approach the correct box and pick it up.
u3: The mission-designated box is being carried and the task is complete; this is the terminal state and the episode ends. No further objective remains.
